title: Introduction
text: This synthetic fixture section frames medical screening false positives and describes medical screening. It is synthetic fixture content, not real literature.

title: Evaluation
text: Evaluation section: calibrated screening classifier is tested on synthetic screening cohort with specificity at fixed recall. The result is used only for offline GapForge evaluation.

title: Limitations
text: Limitations section: deployment shift and source coverage remain unresolved for medical screening; adjacent industrial quality control evidence is only partial.
